core_claims: Standard Softmax attention is constrained to the positive-definite probability simplex, making active destructive cancellation of superseded/invalidated historical premises impossible.

Extending RoPE to a non-orientable fiber bundle over a 1D causal lattice introduces continuous Möbius phase flow Delta_Phi, enabling negative inner products (cos(pi) = -1) that suppress invalidated premises by up to exp(-2 * logit) independently of context length.

Causal path additivity enables exact O(1) KV-cache decoding with zero retroactive cache eviction or modification, naturally supporting topological restoration under double negation (Delta_Phi = 2*pi, cos(2*pi) = +1).

definitions: structure Connection: omega : Position -> Real, omega_nonneg : forall t, 0 <= omega t, omega_le_pi : forall t, omega t <= Real.pi
def Holonomy (A : Connection) (j i : Position) : Real := if j < i then (Finset.Ico (j + 1) (i + 1)).sum A.omega else 0
noncomputable def ParityFactor (A : Connection) (j i : Position) : Real := Real.cos (Holonomy A j i)
